## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Reference a roadmap story ID or issue where applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For model or retrieval changes, link the relevant evaluation and configuration. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its documentation is in English.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and failure paths are covered.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/check_docs.py` for documentation changes.
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, local databases, or model binaries are included.
- [ ] Third-party content includes its provenance and redistribution terms.

The Python foundation exists; RAG and inference remain planned. Do not claim application tests or model benchmarks passed unless you actually ran them.
